cards.ex: Everyone makes mistakes when learning a language.
We need to make a decision by Friday.
cards.exUk: Нам треба ухвалити рішення до п'ятниці.

cards.ex: It's not easy to make friends in a new city.
cards.exUk: Непросто заводити друзів у новому місті.

cards.ex: He makes good money as a freelancer.
You're making great progress with your English!
cards.exUk: Ти робиш великі успіхи в англійській!

cards.ex: Thanks for making the effort to come.
cards.exUk: Дякую, що доклав зусиль і прийшов.

cards.ex: Make sure you lock the door.
Please don't make a noise, the baby is sleeping.
cards.exUk: Будь ласка, не шуміть, малюк спить.

cards.ex: Have you done your homework?
Don't worry about the result, just do your best.
cards.exUk: Не хвилюйся за результат, просто зроби все можливе.

cards.ex: Could you do me a favour and water the plants?
cards.exUk: Можеш зробити мені послугу й полити квіти?

cards.ex: I try to do some exercise every morning.
Let's take a short break.
Can I take a photo here?
Please take a seat, the doctor will see you soon.
cards.exUk: Сідайте, будь ласка, лікар скоро вас прийме.

cards.ex: There's no rush — take your time.
Starting a business means taking a risk.
We took part in a charity run.
cards.exUk: Ми взяли участь у благодійному забігу.

cards.ex: Don't worry, I'll take care of everything.
cards.exUk: Не хвилюйся, я про все подбаю.

cards.ex: Did you have a good time at the party?
cards.exUk: Ти добре провів час на вечірці?

cards.ex: Can I have a look at your photos?
I'll have a quick shower and then we can go.
cards.exUk: Я швидко прийму душ, і можемо йти.

cards.ex: They had an argument about money.
We got married in 2019.
Take a map so you don't get lost.
Your pronunciation is getting better.
She got a job at a bank.
cards.exUk: Вона влаштувалася на роботу в банк.

cards.ex: Pay attention to the road!
We paid a visit to my parents.
He always keeps his promises.
Never break a promise to a child.
cards.exUk: Ніколи не порушуй обіцянку, дану дитині.

cards.ex: To tell the truth, I forgot about it.
cards.exUk: Правду кажучи, я про це забув.

cards.ex: He's great at telling jokes.
I left without saying goodbye.
Wear a hat or you'll catch a cold.
Ordering online saves a lot of time.
There was heavy traffic because of the heavy rain.
cards.exUk: Через сильний дощ був щільний рух.

cards.ex: I need a strong coffee this morning.
cards.exUk: Мені сьогодні вранці потрібна міцна кава.

cards.ex: The restaurant comes highly recommended.
Sorry, the hotel is fully booked.
cards.exUk: Вибачте, у готелі немає вільних місць.
